WEECAP is transforming the West African cashew sector by aligning inclusion and competitiveness to capture global demand, attract investment, and open up economic opportunities for young women and men. WEECAP tackles sector bottlenecks by connecting suppliers with strategic buyers, structuring resilient value chains, and mobilizing targeted financial solutions. At the same time, we strengthen the capacity of emerging businesses, help build robust policy frameworks, and foster concrete results through a practical, market-driven approach. Our ambition: To make the cashew sector a regional engine of competitiveness, value addition, and inclusion. Create 330,000 jobs for young women and men through dynamic value chains and growing enterprises Mobilize $150 million in new investments through innovative financial solutions and private partnerships WEECAP acts as a catalyst—aligning supply chains, scaling up promising business models, deploying capital adapted to real business cycles, and supporting policy reforms that unlock sector growth. Inclusion isn’t an afterthought; it’s a lever for performance and market success. Our goal is a modern, competitive, and inclusive industry where women and youth are full economic actors. Position Overview The Business Development Manager will lead strategic efforts to build the competitiveness of West Africa’s cashew processing industry by unlocking market opportunities, developing sustainable business partnerships, and supporting processors to meet quality and certification standards. The role focuses on expanding market access - particularly for high-growth potential processors—through partnerships with international buyers, structured commercial agreements, and inclusive supply chain models. Ultimately, the Business Development Manager will help translate market opportunities and stronger processor competitiveness into tangible job creation outcomes, particularly for young women and men across the cashew value chain. Key Responsibilities Strategic Planning In collaboration with the Director of Competitiveness, develop a work plan with concrete objectives and a timetable to support the development of processors and producers’ organizations Market Development and Access Build relationships with processors, producer associations and other cashew sector stakeholders Identify and facilitate new buyer relationships in domestic, regional, and international markets Lead strategic market development for processed cashew kernels and derivative products (e.g., broken pieces, cashew apple, shells,). Identify market opportunities with strong potential to generate sustainable jobs for young women and men across the cashew value chain. Identify and facilitate new buyer relationships in domestic, regional, and international markets. Structure long-term purchasing agreements and sustainable sourcing partnerships with buyers. Support processors in obtaining food safety, sustainability certifications and traceability certifications. Business Partnership Structuring to foster job creation Facilitate co-investment models and inclusive partnerships between processors, micro-enterprises, and producer organizations Design and implement backward integration strategies linking processors to young women and men-led supply chains. Drive inter-firm collaboration and regional alliances to meet volume and quality demands. Design and implement backward integration strategies linking processors to young women and men-led supply chains. Processor Competitiveness Support Link processors to integrated business advisory service packages tailored to processor needs. Support processors to host international buyer visits and scale sustainable sourcing practices. Facilitate co-investment models and inclusive partnerships between processors, micro-enterprises and Producer Organizations (POs). Market Intelligence and Analysis Lead market analysis and intelligence to inform market entry and pricing strategies Contribute to market analytics to identify high-return market segments. Guide processors on product and marketing diversification strategies and competitive pricing. Assess investment opportunities with WEECAP supply chain and access to finance activities for coordinated business support. Networking And Promotion Represent the project at trade fairs and industry events and provide coaching for processors attending trade fairs and other industry events when necessary Build a network of market-ready processors and facilitate matchmaking. Collaborate with industry associations and federations to expand sustainable sourcing networks. Capacity Building Support Business Development Service Providers in delivering integrated business advisory packages tailored to processor needs Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Agribusiness, Economics, or related field. Master's preferred. Preferred Experience At least 7 years of experience in agribusiness, food processing, or supply chain development. Strong knowledge of cashew value chains and buyer networks. Success in market access, business to business partnerships, certification, and QMS adoption. Experience working with diverse agribusiness firms and producer organizations in West Africa. Excellent communication, negotiation, and facilitation skills. Willingness to travel within WAEMU countries. This Position Reports To Head of Treasury Middle Office and Controls You will be a member of the Treasury Middle Office and Controls team, responsible for ensuring the accurate accounting, reporting, reconciliation, and control of treasury activities across ABB Robotics. The role will play a key part in maintaining the integrity of treasury data within Kyriba, supporting treasury accounting processes, and ensuring treasury transactions are correctly reflected in financial reporting systems. Beyond supporting day-to-day treasury accounting and controls activities, you will contribute to building and enhancing the treasury operating model, systems landscape, and control framework of ABB Robotics as it transitions into a standalone company. The location of the role is flexible within Europe. The working model is hybrid Your Responsibilities Own Treasury Accounting & Month-End Close: Take ownership of treasury accounting and reporting activities, playing a key role in the month-end close process and ensuring treasury transactions and balances are accurately recorded and reflected in the financial reporting systems. Ensure Accurate Reconciliations & Controls: Review, validate and reconcile treasury-related accounting entries and balances between Kyriba, SAP and other financial systems. Work closely with FAO on pre- and post-closing checks, investigate discrepancies and ensure the accuracy and completeness of treasury records. Manage Treasury Data & Accounting Set-up: Ensure the accuracy and integrity of treasury transaction data and accounting configurations in Kyriba, covering bank accounts, cash pools, short- and long-term loans, FX forwards and swaps, investments and guarantees. Strengthen Processes, Policies & Controls: Maintain and continuously improve treasury accounting processes, models, policies, procedures and controls. Support audit and SOX requirements, identify operational risks and drive improvements to strengthen the treasury control framework. Enable Effective Treasury Systems: Support treasury system enhancements, testing, integrations and implementation activities, acting as a key interface between Treasury, Accounting and IS teams to ensure effective processes, systems and data flows. Drive Automation & Transformation: Contribute to treasury transformation initiatives, including the development of the Treasury Operating Model, process automation and the use of data analytics and AI-enabled solutions to improve treasury processes, controls and reporting. Your Background Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration or a related field; an accounting qualification such as ACCA, CPA, CIMA or equivalent is a strong plus. At least 5 years’ experience in Treasury Accounting, Financial Accounting, Controlling, Treasury Operations or a similar Middle Office function, ideally in a multinational environment. Strong hands-on experience in month-end closing processes, including reviewing and validating accounting entries, performing account reconciliations and investigating discrepancies. Solid knowledge of treasury products and their accounting treatment, particularly short- and long-term loans, FX forwards and FX swaps; exposure to cash pools, investments, guarantees or trade finance is an advantage. Experience working with Treasury Management Systems and ERP systems; Kyriba and SAP experience is considered an advantage. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a high level of accuracy and attention to detail, and a proactive, collaborative mindset. Interest or experience in process automation, data analytics or AI-enabled solutions is highly valued. Fluent English is required; other languages are a plus. Please submit your application in English. We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
